tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po gsal byed kyi man ngag bzhugs//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pra ka ra sa ma u pa de sha ma hā mu dra/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgo nas lhan skyes/ chen po rab tu gsal gzhi ma bcos pa/ bar bya ba'i man ngag /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi dang nang dang po rnon po/ kun phyag rgya che// phyag rgya chen lhan skyes khams su/ po'i ngang nyid la// mtshan ma med pa/ sems nyid rang bzhin med par/ bcos pa ga la yod// snang srid thams sa gsum pa thabs lam blos ma dpyad pa/ cad chos kyi sku// phyag rgya chen lhan skyes la goms pa/ po'i ngang nyid la// snang ba med pa phyag rgya che// ma bcos rig pa gcig pu/ bzhag na sgom pa yin// bsam du med pa chos kyi sku// ma btsal dbang po'i spyod yul du/ bzhag na bsgom pa yin// cer re bltas pa'i ngo bo tha dad med/ dus nyid du// gnyis su rnam par rtog pa/ med par shes par bya// 'di ltar snang ba'i lhan skyes la goms pas/ dngos po dang*// stong pa nyid du rtogs pa ni// (2na)dus mnyam snga phyi dag tu med par/ dag tu 'dod pa yin// dper na sngar 'dris pa yi mi// mthong ma thag tu mthong bas 'gyur med du shes par bya/ ngo shes bzhin// sems kyi snang ba rtog pa la/ sna tshogs kun// mang po dag tu rtog pa chos skur/ 'char ba yang*// stong pa nyid du dbyer med par/ rtogs pa ni// dper na rgya mtshor kha ba ni// babs tshad chu ru 'gro ba rang bzhin med pa skye med lhan skyes kyi khongs su 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu rtogs dgos/ bzhin// de bzhin snang phyi rol tshogs drug gi yul du/ ba thams cad ni// skye ba med par dper na sgyu ma ltar shes par bya/ rtogs par bya// rig pa'i rgyun du goms pa bsrings ba la brten nas/ dngos po snang ba nyid// ngo bo stong pa nyid yin te// rgya mtshor zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin// sems kyi rang bzhin

nyams su myong ba ste/ skye med du// goms par blos ma bcos par bya/ byas nas bsgoms pa yin// dus med par bya/ sgom pa zhes pa tha snyad de// tha snyad rang cir snang thams cad rang bzhin med pa/ bzhin skye med do// (2ba)tshad du gtad sems 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ la sgom rgyu med// thun du bcad la sgom rgyu med// gang ltar snang ba bsgom pa yin// logs su rang rig rang gsal las/ bkar bas sgom rgyu med// rgyun mi chad du sgom pa yin// sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs pa las// sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal du med// de la rmongs rnams skal pa dang las 'phro med pa'i gang zag rnams/ 'di ltar 'dod// chos sku de nyid sgom pa la/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob med kyang*/ byis pa'i skye bo 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin can 'ga' zhig /mnyam bzhag rjes thob dag tu 'dod/ pa ni nor ba'o// /'khor ba'i rang bzhin skye ba med par/ rtogs pa las/ gzhan du thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa logs na med/ btsal du/ bde sdug la sogs /gang ltar snang ba de nyid rang rtogs na/ de chos yin/ kyi dbyings/ /gang ltar gsal ba chos nyid yin// dbang po lnga yi spyod yul du// snang ba thams cad gnyis su med// khams gsum ye nas sangs rgyas yin// 'khor ba ye nas myang 'das yin// sems can ye nas sangs rgyas yin// nyon mongs ye nas byang chub yin// 'on kyang ye nas ma rtogs pas// khams gsum pa ni 'khor ba yin// 'khor ba las ni bzlog pa ni// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dgos// bla mas ma bstan bar du ni// dbul po'i gter ni ji bzhin du// rang la yod kyang phan ma thogs// de bas bla ma'i gdams ngag gces// 'di dag rtogs nas nyams su long*// kun rdzob don dam gnyis med de// chos kyi sku yi mtshan nyid do// sangs rgyas dgongs pa mthar thug yin// phyag rgya chen po mthar thug pa mdor bsdus pa'o/// /bla ma'i zhal nas/

'di ltar ma rtogs (3na)na 'khor ba las grol thabs med gsung*/ 'di ltar rtogs pa shes par ngos bzung nas goms par nyams su blangs/ lta bas thag bcad pa gal che gsung*/// /na mo gu ru/ rang rig rang gsal rang la gnas// bum pa nang gi mar me bzhin// shes pa rang gsal tsam du gnas// tha snyad chig tu brjod tsam na// 'od gsal bya bar ming du btags// bde stong bya bar ming du btags// rig stong bya bar ming du btags// snang stong bya bar ming du btags// btags pa tsam las ming du bas// zhes gsungs so/// /rtogs ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po rtogs par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ gang gis mi bskyod rgya mtsho lta bur gzhag /nyon mongs pa la thog rdugs med pas skyi ser lta bur gzhag /'khor 'das dbyer med yin pas chos nyid ngang du gzhag /dug gsum rang bzhin chos kyi sku yin te// sems nyid lhan cig skyes par mkhyen par mdzod// snang grags thams cad gnyug ma'i ngang yin te// gdod nas rtsol sgrub bral bar mkhyen par mdzod// rnam rtog ma spangs chos nyid rang bzhin te// ma bcos rang sar grol bar mkhyen par mdzod// de ltar rtogs na sku gsum rang bzhin te// 'bras bu bsgrub tu med par mkhyen par mdzod// e ma ho chos rnams lhan cig skyes pa'i sa// rang bzhin mi dmigs bsgom du med pa'i ngang*// rnam rtog rang bzhin skye med chos sku'i ngang*// ma bsam lhun gyis grub pa chos kyi sku// dus gsum mnyam par snang bas gnyug ma'i lam// rang bzhin spros dang bral ba rnal 'byor sems// sku gsum rang la shar ba skye med thugs// (3ba)'khor 'das thams cad gnyug ma'i klong du thim// gzung 'dzin thams cad skye med dbyings su yal// rtsol sgrub thams cad ma bcos lam du slongs// 'bras bu thams cad thob tu med par shar// phyag rgya chen po brjod du med pa'i don ces bya ba slob dpon sgom tshul gyis mdzad pa'o/// /na mo gu ru/

bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos rnams thams cad ma lus pa// rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las byung yin// mi dge ma lus mtha' dag spangs// dge ba ma lus nyams su len// de ni bkra shis phun tshogs yin// bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du de dang mi 'bral bar bgyi'o// zhes gsung ngo// yang zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung thos nas// tshe 'di blo yis btang nas kyang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad rgyab tu bor// chags zhen med pa'i sgom chen bde// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di// skye ba med pa chos kyi sku// gsal la ma 'gags nyams su myong*// sna tshogs snang ba'i mtshan nyid yin// de yang bag chags gzugs brnyan lags// 'od gsal dang zung 'jug rtogs pa yis// dran med kyi lta bas ma bslus tsam// gzhan med kyi bde stong nyams su shar// rtogs med kyi lteng pos ma bslus tsam// yod med gnyis las 'das pa bde// yin min rtsi dang bral bas bde// rtag chad yul dang bral bas bde// blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid de// rang la shar bas ngo mtshar che// phyogs su byed pa'i lta ba dang*// zhen dang ma bral sgom pa dang*// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i spyod pa gsum// 'jig rten pa yi lta spyod lags// zhes gsung ngo*// yang zhal nas/ rang sems rtogs nas de las gzhan med go ba'i sgom chen bde// bsgom rgyu (4na)med par rang sems rnal mar bzhag pas chog pa'i sgrub pa po bde// ngo bo rnal mar shes pas nges shes skyes// skye 'jig bral bar go ba'i rnal 'byor bde// rang sems skye ba med pa lta bar mthong*// skye med don la rtse gcig sgom par go /de las yengs pa med pa spyod par go /rang gi sems nyid bsgom pa gcig pus chog /bsam du med pa'i bsam gtan// bsgom du med pa'i bsgom pa// gza' gtad med pa ngo bo gsal// dus gsum rgyun du lhang nge gnas// zhes gsungs pas bla ma'i zhal nas// khyod kyi de yang yin te/

don rnal mar song na 'di lta bu zhig dgos gsungs/ e ma ho/ shes bya gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa de// zhen pa bral yang don ma mthong*// gnyis 'dzin ma bral sgom pa de// nyams su myong yang don ma mthong*// rtogs pa med pa'i lta ba de// mtha' bral zer yang blos byas yin// ltos thag ma chod sgom chen de// ting 'dzin bzang yang 'khor ba'i rgyu// snying rje med pa'i chos pa de// 'bad rtsol byas kyang nyan thos lam// a kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// shes gsung ngo*// bla ma'i zhal nas/ rang gi sems la lta ba sems su gyis// rang gi sems la lta ba goms tsa na// yul sems gnyis su ma bzung bas// gnyis med ye shes nyams su myong*// thabs kyi khyad par bstan pa yin// thob pa'i dus nyid bstan pa yin// zhes gsung ngo*// phyag rgya chen po gsal byed kyi man ngag ces bya ba'o// rje zla 'od gzhon nus mdzad pa'o// phyag rgya chen po gsal byed kyi man ngag 'di la chos tshan brgyad yod/// /na mo gu ru/ rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros thor bu lags/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir yang sgom (4ba)chen la gol sa mang*/ de yang nyams myong rtogs par shor ba dang*/ rtogs pa nyams myong du shor ba bya ba gnyis so// nyams myong rtogs par shor ba ni/ thabs khyad par can la brten nas bsgoms pas/ rang la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can byung ste/ nga'i shes pa 'di la mi rtog pa dang bde ba dang*/ 'di las lhag pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la yang yod mi 'ong gi snyam pa cig byung ba/ de la yid ches shing mchog tu bzung nas sgom pa de ni/ nyams myong rtogs par shor ba bya ba yin/ des kyang don mi 'grub bo// rtogs pa nyams myong du shor ba bya ba ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rang gi sems kyi ngo bo gcig rtogs pa de la/ nyams bde ba dang gsal ba lta bu cig nang nas rang shar du 'byung*/ de las ma yengs par bsgom/

de res 'ga' ma byung bas mi dga'/ byung na rung pa la snyam/ yang de shes pas 'bad nas tshol te byung ba de la blo bzhag nas sgom pa de/ rtogs pa nyams myong du shor ba bya ba yin te/ des kyang bag mi 'ong*/ byung ma byung khyad med pa cig dgos/ lar sgoms dang da bzod cig gsal bar 'ong gis gsung*/ spyir khams gsum dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ skye mched bzhir gol bar bshad pa de 'dzin pa bag tsam la brten nas gol ba yin/ nyan thos su gol ba ni/ de spyad pa'i stong pa la gol ba yin/ ngo bo 'dzin med du gnas pas gol ba med pa yin gsung ngo*/// /yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig /dbye ba dang gsum/ de la bskyed rim gyi ngo bo ni/ zung 'jug lha'i sku/ nges tshig ni/ rim gyis bskyed pas na bskyed rim/ dbye ba ni bskyed tshul la rnam pa bzhi ste/ sbyang gzhi bya ba'i (5na)rkyen can skye ba rnam bzhi la/ sbyong byed byed pa'i rkyen can bskyed tshul rnam bzhi'i 'byung ba yin/ bskyed rim gyi dgos pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ tha mal gyi lus po khams dang skye mched kyi rtog pa las bzlog pa dang*/ bar du zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bsgrub pa dang*/ tha mar sku gnyis gzhan don du 'byung ba yin/ rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo spros bral/ nges tshig ni/ rdzogs pas na rdzogs rim/ dbye ba ni/ mtshan bcas dang*/ mtshan med gnyis/ rdzogs rim gyi dgos pa ni/ bskyed rim las khyad par du byas te/ ye shes mngon du ston par byed pa dang*/ mthar chos sku thob par byed pa yin te/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rab skad cig dran rdzogs/ 'bring dang tha ma cho ga rim gyis sgom pa yin/ de 'ja' tshon lta bur sgom/ dngos po a thang chad par sgom du mi rung ba yin gsung*/// /yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ dad pa gal che gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshol ba yang dad pa yin te/

dad pa la gsum/ rab kyis yid ches pa'i dad pa sgom/ 'bring gis 'dod pa'i dad pa bsgom/ tha mas dang ba'i dad pa sgom gsung*/ yid ches pa'i dad pa ni rgyu 'bras la yid ches pas skye'o// 'dod pa'i dad pa ni bden bzhi la brten nas skye'o// dang ba'i dad pa ni yul khyad par can la brten nas skye'o// dad pa de brtan par byed pa la yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na/ dad pas sdig pa'i grogs dang phrad pa yin gsung*/ de bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gal che tshul du 'dug /yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ rgyud dkrugs/ lung bcus/ (5ba)man ngag gab/ rgyud kyi nang na mar dang po brjod bya bstan nas/ de nas rdzogs rim 'chad/ de nas bskyed rim 'chad/ de nas yan lag bdun pa 'chad de/ rgyud dkrugs pa bya ba yin gsung*/ slob dpon khams pa chen po rnams kyis lung bsdu ba'i bstan bcos dang lung bkrol ba'i bstan bcos bya ba gsungs te/ lung bkrol ba'i bstan bcos ni 'grel pa dang ṭī kā la sogs pa yin gsung*/ lung bsdu ba'i bstan bcos ni sgrub thabs yin te/ de ni man ngag gab pa yin gsung*/ sangs rgyas kyis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin nyams su blangs kyang bla ma med na byin rlabs mi 'byung gsung*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/ phyag kyang sngon du bla ma la 'bul/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas tha dad med pa yin te/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin// tha dad par ni mi brtag go /zhes gsungs so/// /yang*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems kyi rang bzhin// ngo bo/ mtshan nyid gsum yin/ sems kyi rang bzhin bya ba/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab pa'i 'dus ma byas de yin no// sems kyi ngo bo bya ba/ rig pa skye 'gag med pa de yin no// sems kyi mtshan nyid bya ba/ bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan sna tshogs su snang ba 'di yin no// 'o na gang bsgom na sems kyi ngo bo sgom pa bya ba yin/

de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs/ byang chub sems dpa'i thugs/ srid pa drug gi sems can gyi rang rig pa'i ngo bo gsal la go ma 'gags pa 'di sgom (6na)pa yin te/ sgrib pa ma zad pas rgyun du 'grogs kyang zhal ma mthong*/ yang na sla ba yin te gzhan nas btsal ma dgos/ rang la yod de nga'i sems zer ba 'di yin/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs la lta ba min/ ngo bo ma bcos pa rang gsal tsam du sing nge ye re ba 'di rang yin/ lar jo bo pa rnams 'di ngo ma shes kyi bar du phyogs mtha' dag nas 'bung dgos/ da res cig ma thar na/ phyis dal 'byor la phyi phyag 'tshal nas/ ye'u zer nas ngan song 'ba' zhig tu kha bltas nas 'gro nyen yod pas/ snying thag pa nas chos gyis/ nga'i snying 'di bya ba yang dmar po ltar ltar po gcig las med gsung pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan mnga' ba/ dang 'dra ba yin no// snying nas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad bzhag nas sgrub pa cig byed dgos pa yin/ las 'bras la shin tu 'dzem pa cig dgos/ nga la rnal 'byor pa zer te/ nga ni las 'bras la shin tu 'dzem pa yin/ dge ba'i spyan snga ba/ mchan/ nga'i bla ma rnams kyi man ngag yin/ las 'bras la yel le phyod de 'dug na chos gnad du ma phog pa yin/ lta ba mtho ba skad zer yang mi phan pas/ 'o cag rang mi la sdig mi bsag /chos kyi zhal che mi bcad/ 'di gnyis nyen che/ ma mthong ba'i g.yang sar bshad/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus par zad pa'i rgyu yin/ de bas tshe la long med/ lo 'ga'/ zla ba 'ga'/ zhag 'ga'i bar 'di la don ci 'grub byed dgos pa yin no// snying nas sgrub pa byed pa la/ sangs rgya ba dus yun ring po mi dgos gsung ngo*/// /
